schema.text: With regard to accidents and road conditions, how safe do the routes you usually take seem to you?
schema.help: Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls and dangerous road conditions, not crime.

en.#With regard to accidents and road condi: With regard to accidents and road conditions, how safe do the routes you usually take seem to you?
en.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls and dangerous road conditions, not crime.

it.#With regard to accidents and road condi: Rispetto a incidenti e condizioni delle strade, quanto ti sembrano sicuri i percorsi che fai abitualmente?
it.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: Qui intendiamo il rischio di incidenti, cadute e condizioni stradali pericolose, non la criminalità.

fr.#With regard to accidents and road condi: En ce qui concerne les accidents et l’état des routes, à quel point les itinéraires que vous empruntez habituellement vous semblent-ils sûrs ?
fr.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: Il s’agit ici du risque de collisions, de chutes et de conditions de circulation dangereuses, et non de la délinquance.

de.#With regard to accidents and road condi: Wie sicher erscheinen Ihnen die Wege, die Sie üblicherweise nehmen, im Hinblick auf Unfälle und den Straßenzustand?
de.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: Gemeint ist hier das Risiko von Unfällen, Stürzen und gefährlichen Straßenverhältnissen, nicht Kriminalität.

tr.#With regard to accidents and road condi: Kazalar ve yol koşulları açısından, genellikle kullandığınız güzergâhlar size ne kadar güvenli görünüyor?
tr.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: Burada suçu değil, çarpışma, düşme ve tehlikeli yol koşulları riskini kastediyoruz.

fa.#With regard to accidents and road condi: از نظر تصادف و وضعیت راه‌ها، مسیرهایی که معمولاً طی می‌کنید چقدر به نظرتان ایمن هستند؟
fa.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: منظور ما در اینجا خطر تصادف، زمین خوردن و شرایط خطرناک راه است، نه جرم و جنایت.

hu.#With regard to accidents and road condi: A balesetek és az utak állapota szempontjából mennyire tűnnek biztonságosnak azok az útvonalak, amelyeken általában közlekedik?
hu.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: Itt az ütközések, elesések és veszélyes útviszonyok kockázatára gondolunk, nem a bűnözésre.

ar.#With regard to accidents and road condi: فيما يتعلق بالحوادث وحالة الطرق، ما مدى أمان المسارات التي تسلكها عادةً في نظرك؟
ar.#Here we mean the risk of crashes, falls: نقصد هنا خطر الاصطدامات والسقوط وظروف الطريق الخطرة، وليس الجريمة.
